raw: I misspelled a name on a birthday cake once. I’d put an extra letter in the icing, and the birthday boy was the one who spotted it. That was the embarrassing part—he noticed his own name was wrong before I did. I looked at it again, and then the extra letter seemed so obvious. Names are funny that way, you can look right at one and think it looks fine, and then once you see the mistake, it’s all you can see. I’d wanted it to look nice for him, and instead there was this mistake right on the cake. I felt very awkward about that.
